job.title: Senior Full-Stack-Entwickler:in (gn) in Dortmund & Düsseldorf - KEINE ÜBERSTUNDEN - 2 TAGE REMOTE

tailoring.headline: Senior Full-Stack E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) | Java & Spring Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs, with a strong track record in full-stack development, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker. I excel in techno-functional roles, bridging business requirements with technical implementation. I am highly experienced in delivering performant, scalable web solutions and collaborating directly with international stakeholders to align business goals with technical architecture.

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Full-Stack-Entwickler:in (gn)
cover_en.hook: I am excited to apply for the Senior Full-Stack Developer position at EXWE. With over 5 years of experience delivering complex e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to bring my expertise in Java-based enterprise platforms and API-driven development to your team in Dortmund.

bullets.label: Full-Stack Expertise
bullets.text: I have extensive experience in full-stack development, from designing backend architecture and RESTful APIs to implementing responsive storefront features.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: I specialize in translating complex business requirements into performant technical solutions, ensuring that every feature aligns with client goals.

bullets.label: DevOps & Quality
bullets.text: I am highly proficient in CI/CD deployment cycles, Docker, and automated testing, ensuring high-quality, stable releases for enterprise-grade software.

bullets.label: Client Collaboration
bullets.text: My background includes direct collaboration with international stakeholders, managing requirements, and providing technical guidance to ensure project success.

cover_en.gap: While my core expertise lies in the Java/Spring ecosystem, my deep experience in building scalable, high-performance web architectures allows me to quickly adapt to new frameworks and technologies.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period, with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and availability starting 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience fits your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Full-Stack-Entwickler:in (gn)
cover_de.hook: mit großem Interesse bewerbe ich mich als Senior Full-Stack-Entwickler bei EXWE. Durch meine über fünfjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer E-Commerce-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Kenntnisse in der Java-basierten Softwareentwicklung und der API-Integration mit.

bullets.label: Full-Stack-Expertise
bullets.text: Ich verfüge über umfassende Erfahrung in der Full-Stack-Entwicklung, von der Architekturplanung über das Backend-Coding bis hin zur Implementierung performanter Frontend-Lösungen.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Ich bin darauf spezialisiert, komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen in präzise technische Spezifikationen zu übersetzen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die Business-Ziele direkt unterstützen.

bullets.label: DevOps & Qualität
bullets.text: Durch meine Arbeit mit CI/CD-Pipelines, Docker und automatisierten Testverfahren stelle ich eine hohe Code-Qualität und stabile Releases sicher.

bullets.label: Kundenorientierung
bullets.text: Die direkte Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Stakeholdern und die Verantwortung für die technische Umsetzung von Kundenwünschen gehören zu meinem täglichen Arbeitsalltag.

cover_de.gap: Mein Fokus liegt auf skalierbaren Java-Architekturen; meine Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Web-Systeme ermöglicht es mir, mich schnell in neue Frameworks einzuarbeiten.
cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe und besitze eine unbefristete Arbeitserlaubnis. Mein letzter Arbeitstag ist der 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 für neue Herausforderungen zur Verfügung stehe. Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: EXWE's focus on sustainable software development and the balance between high-quality technical output and team well-being resonates with my professional values. I am impressed by your commitment to creating individual web solutions that drive digital progress. I want to contribute my experience in enterprise e-commerce and my passion for clean, performant code to a team that values collaboration, responsibility, and continuous growth.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am a dedicated developer passionate about building high-quality, user-centric e-commerce solutions. I thrive in collaborative environments where I can take ownership of technical projects and contribute to the professional growth of my team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I'm a Senior Full-Stack Developer with 5+ years of experience in enterprise e-commerce (SAP Commerce/Java). I'm very interested in the Senior Full-Stack role at EXWE and have just submitted my application. Would love to connect!
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Full-Stack-Entwickler:in position at EXWE. With over 5 years of experience in enterprise e-commerce development and a strong background in Java, Spring, and API-driven architecture, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your team's success. I am currently serving my notice period and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the possibility of discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
